scope: Dragonflight prospecting Frontier scenario snapshot and input validation
reviewerRole: Separate reviewer who did not author the model, manifest, or regression changes

acceptedControls: Plain and frozen two-output scenarios each preserve both entries, return 17 synthetic gold, and select the alternative.
rejectedBeforeCallback: Accessor on an output record field
Output array proxy that shrinks and regrows
Output-record proxy that replaces a sibling while preserving array length
Output-record proxy that leaves the array shortened
Output-record proxy that shrinks and restores array length with a different sibling
Output-record proxy that reenters evaluation before replacing a sibling
Scenario proxy that replaces an output while returning the same array reference

findings: Initial PR model blob 190f2d4b94e2079eacbd413bc793e60e2b494bee rejected direct array proxies while accepting nested and top-level record proxies. In the independent synthetic control, replacing a sibling changed 17 gold and an alternative-wins scenario to 107 gold and a prospect-wins scenario. The reentrant variant returned 124 gold.
The reviewed model rejects proxies before record reflection, takes values from validated own data descriptors, and keeps the plain and frozen controls preview-only at confidence zero.
The historical F005 fixture retains its original Git blob. The author regression and this separately executed review are separate records.

reproduction.provenance: The runner preserves the cases from the recovered original review script. It adds pin checks, explicit expectations and per-case output for replay. The original recorded execution and verdict are unchanged.
